key_insight: The study releases a large, curated Swedish pediatric CNS tumor histopathology dataset to support AI-driven diagnosis and subtype classification.
clinical_relevance: By improving access to diverse pediatric brain tumor slides and linked molecular data, the resource could help advance more precise and standardized pathology workflows.
method: Collected H&E whole-slide images from pediatric CNS tumor samples across all six Swedish pediatric oncology centers (2013–2023).
Curated confirmed diagnoses and diagnostic-relevant clinical information for 537 unique subjects (562 subject-diagnosis pair cases).
Linked the slide resource to separate WGS, WTS, and methylation data available for most samples through the Swedish Childhood Tumor Biobank.
evidence_signal: The dataset includes 1,446 high-quality WSIs with confirmed CNS tumor diagnoses, making it a substantial resource for model development rather than a performance-evaluation study.
watch_item: As a curated national biobank dataset, it may still require external validation before AI models trained on it can be used reliably across other hospitals or imaging workflows.
paper_title: A MULTICENTER SWEDISH HISTOPATHOLOGY IMAGE DATASET OF PEDIATRIC CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM TUMORS
